values.name: Allowance

values.name: Charge
values.description: (5424) Charge expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Allowance or charge
values.description: [5424] Allowance or charge expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Reinsurer's share
values.description: To indicate the share of the reinsurer in a treaty.

values.name: Entry percentage
values.description: To indicate the percentage used for the specified entry (e.g. commission %, deposits % ...).

values.name: Quality/yield
values.description: (6318) The percentage of a specified material in the total product.

values.name: Percentage of invoice
values.description: Code specifying the percentage of invoice.

values.name: Reduction/surcharge percentage
values.description: Percentage to calculate a reduction/surcharge.

values.name: Adjustment
values.description: Code specifying the adjustment expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Bureau share
values.description: London insurance market bureau (bureau share in reinsurance treaty).

values.name: Buffer stock requirement
values.description: Anticipated additional consumption to safeguard against unforeseen shortages or demands.

values.name: Discount
values.description: Discount expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Amount tolerance
values.description: Tolerance of amount in percentage.

values.name: Percentage of note
values.description: Percentage of debit or credit note.

values.name: Penalty percentage
values.description: Code specifying the penalty percentage.

values.name: Interest percentage
values.description: Code specifying the interest percentage.

values.name: Part of documentary credit amount
values.description: Part of documentary credit amount in percentage subject to sight payment, deferred payment or acceptance when the documentary credit is available by mixed payment.

values.name: Percentage credit note
values.description: Percentage of a credit note.

values.name: Percentage debit note
values.description: Percentage of a debit note.

values.name: Percentage of insurance
values.description: Code specifying the percentage of insurance.

values.name: Own risk percentage
values.description: Percentage of total amount which is not covered by credit cover.

values.name: Transferred VAT percentage
values.description: VAT percentage rate for which accountability is being transferred from one party to another. VAT means: Value added tax.

values.name: Part time employment
values.description: The time a person is employed expressed as a percentage of the equivalent full time employment.

values.name: Voluntary contribution
values.description: Contribution to a superannuation scheme which is not compulsory, expressed as a percentage of salary.

values.name: Attribute factor
values.description: To indicate a mathematical factor, expressed as a percentage , used to multiply a specified attribute item.

values.name: Additional contribution
values.description: Contribution to a scheme in addition to the normal contribution, expressed as a percentage (in superannuation usually expressed as a percentage of salary).

values.name: Benefits allocation
values.description: Percentage of total benefits allocated to a person.

values.name: Attribute classification
values.description: To indicate the percentage of a specified attribute classification (e.g. percentage contributed before a defined year for superannuation purposes).

values.name: Renegotiation trigger upper limit
values.description: The percentage rise in a currency rate of exchange which would result in renegotiation of prices.

values.name: Renegotiation trigger lower limit
values.description: The percentage fall in a currency rate of exchange which would result in renegotiation of prices.

values.name: Material reduction factor
values.description: The percentage reduction in constituent material which occurs in the production process.

values.name: Acceptable price difference
values.description: The maximum percentage increase or decrease resulting from price recalculation which will not result in price renegotiation.

values.name: Share of buyer's total requirement
values.description: The percentage of the buyer's total acquisition requirement for the referenced or similar item which will be ordered from the named supplier.

values.name: Price increase
values.description: The percentage increase in price of the referenced item since the last notification.

values.name: Share of tool cost paid by buyer
values.description: The percentage of the cost of tooling which will be paid by the buyer.

values.name: Volume capacity usage
values.description: Percentage of the volume capacity used.

values.name: Weight capacity usage
values.description: Percentage of the weight capacity used.

values.name: Loading length capacity usage
values.description: Percentage of the loading length capacity used.

values.name: Share of packaging cost paid by vendor
values.description: The percentage of the cost of packaging which will be paid by the vendor.

values.name: Reduction percentage
values.description: Reduction from an amount/price expressed in a percentage.

values.name: Surcharge percentage
values.description: Additional amount expressed in a percentage.

values.name: Local content
values.description: To indicate the percentage of a products local (i.e. domestic) content.

values.name: Chargeback
values.description: Percentage amount charged back.

values.name: Gross turnover commission
values.description: Percentage of gross turnover used to calculate commission.

values.name: Progress payment percentage
values.description: Indicates the rate applying for a progress payment.

values.name: Offset
values.description: Indicates the figure agreed between parties to calculate an offset.

values.name: Prepaid payment percentage
values.description: A code to indicate the percentage of the prepayment.

values.name: Percentage of work completed
values.description: A code to indicate the percentage of work completed.

values.name: Underwriting rating
values.description: Table used for mortality or morbidity rating.

values.name: Mortgage interest rate
values.description: Rate of interest used in amortization of a mortgage.

values.name: Maximum cost of living adjustment rate
values.description: Maximum rate of the cost of living adjustment.

values.name: Humidity
values.description: The amount of moisture in the air.

values.name: Minimum cost of living adjustment rate
values.description: Minimum rate of a cost of living adjustment.

values.name: Contractor cost share
values.description: The cost share borne by the contractor.

values.name: Government cost share
values.description: The cost share borne by the Government.

values.name: Progress payment liquidation percentage
values.description: The percentage applied to the liquidation of progress payments.

values.name: Fee percentage
values.description: The percentage applied to determine the fee.

values.name: Resource availability
values.description: Percentage of resource availability.

values.name: Resource efficiency
values.description: Percentage of resource efficiency.

values.name: Rework yield

values.name: Gross profit margin

values.name: Remaining work

values.name: Actual work percent completed

values.name: Earned value

values.name: Cost escalation

values.name: Loss

values.name: Cost of living adjustment rate

values.name: Percentage of due amount
values.description: The percentage of an amount due.

values.name: Asset ownership

values.name: Common stock reported

values.name: Preferred stock reported
values.description: Percentage of preferred stock reported.

values.name: Ordinary profit to sales

values.name: Invested capital ratio

values.name: Equity to deposit ratio
values.description: Ratio of equity to deposits expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Loan to deposit ratio
values.description: Ratio of outstanding loans to deposits expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Indebtedness

values.name: Liquid ratio
values.description: Ratio of liquid assets to current liabilities.

values.name: Net worth to total assets
values.description: Ratio of net worth to total assets expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Subcontracted
values.description: Percentage of work that is subcontracted.

values.name: Sales per employee

values.description: Net profit after taxes divided by capital.

values.description: Net profit after taxes divided by net worth.

values.name: Contracts obtained by bid

values.name: Contracts obtained by negotiation
values.description: Percentage of contracts obtained by negotiation.

values.name: Cost plus basis

values.name: Purchases on letter of credit

values.description: The return on equity achieved by a minority interest in an entity.

values.description: The percentage applied to determine the profit.

values.description: The percentage of the cost over-run incurred by the contractor.

values.description: The percentage of the cost under-run allocated to the contractor.

values.description: Ratio calculated by dividing current liabilities by total liabilities expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Current assets to total liabilities
values.description: Ratio calculated by dividing current assets by total liabilities expressed as a percentage.

values.description: The compilation of the total calculated volume vessel measurements, adjusted for on-board quantity or remaining on-board quantity, compared with the total calculated volume shore measurements expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Vessel load ratio
values.description: The total calculated volume by vessel measurement upon sailing, less on-board quantity, divided by the total calculated volume by shore measurement at loading expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Vessel discharge ratio
values.description: The total calculated volume by vessel measurement on arrival, less remaining on board, divided by the total calculated volume by shore measurement discharge expressed as a percentage.

values.name: National average percentile
values.description: Relative ranking for a corresponding class to the national average.

values.name: Industry average percentile
values.description: Relative ranking for a corresponding class to the industry average.

values.name: Non-current assets to net worth
values.description: The ratio of non-current assets to net worth expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Non-current assets to total assets
values.description: The ratio of non-current assets to total assets expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Sales to current assets
values.description: The ratio of sales to current assets expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Working capital to sales
values.description: The ratio of working capital to sales expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Creditors to sales costs
values.description: The ratio of creditors to sales costs expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Concentration
values.description: Concentration expressed as a percentage value.

values.name: Percentage of months before an instalment
values.description: The number of months before an instalment is made expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Accounts receivable turnover
values.description: Net annual sales divided by accounts receivable.

values.name: Employee costs to value added ratio
values.description: Ratio of employee costs to total income minus raw materials and sales costs expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Interest payable to net sales ratio
values.description: Ratio of interest payable divided by net sales expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Inventory to cost of goods sold ratio
values.description: Ratio of inventory divided by cost of goods sold expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Liquid assets to sales ratio
values.description: Ratio of liquid assets divided by net sales expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Return on value added ratio
values.description: Ratio of total income minus raw materials and services to net sales expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Daily working capital need
values.description: The value of working capital divided by net sales multiplied by 360.

values.name: Financial expenses to net sales ratio
values.description: The ratio of financial expenses to net sales expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Inflation
values.description: Percentage representing a general increase in prices and fall in the purchasing value of money.

values.name: Probability of financial distress
values.description: The probability of financial distress expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Gearing
values.description: Ratio of the total short and long term loans divided by shareholder equity expressed as a percentage.

values.name: Nestable percentage
values.description: Extent expressed as a percentage to which an item can be nested within an identical item.

values.name: Mutually defined
values.description: As agreed by the trading partners.
